messages.text: The issue is that `.editor-pane` has `overflow: auto` (making it scrollable) **and** `.editor-code-wrap` has `overflow-x: auto` (also scrollable). The YAML pane needs the pane to handle scrolling, not the inner wrap.

messages.text: Fixed. The code pane keeps `overflow: hidden` (no scrollbars, content is decorative), while the YAML pane gets `overflow: auto` on the pane itself and `overflow: visible` on the inner code-wrap — so only one scrollbar appears on the YAML tab.
